reflect_raw_head: [{"op":"add","content":"When explicitly asked for end-to-end repository delivery, completion requires finishing all remaining implementation and tests, verifying the repository, creating conventional commits, pushing the requested branch, and opening the pull request; do not stop after local implementation while any requested delivery step remains.","rationale":"The prior response stopped after local commits instead of completing the requested delivery workflow."},{"op":"add","content":"Before declaring a delivery task blocked, attempt every authorized step, diagnose recoverable failures, and continue all independent steps; report BLOCKED only for a concrete external impediment that prevents a required outcome.","rationale":"Prevents premature blocking when remaining work can still be executed or recovered."},{"op":"add","content":"For repository delivery tasks, report completion only after observing the required test results, successful push, and created pull-request URL; otherwise identify the exact unfinished requirement and evidence.","rationale":"Makes the final status match the user's observable acceptance criteria."}]

holdout_detail.response_head: What specific repository work should I orchestrate—an issue, PR, feature, backlog, or full audit?
holdout_detail.why: It stays focused and asks one necessary clarification before orchestration. No work was specified, so delegation or waiting would be premature, though the category list is slightly broader than needed
